_how: Weekly Record Recap on the stats page: only records and milestones from Allen's most recent game. The live copy is recap.json on the stats-data branch (publish there, no Netlify deploy); this copy on main is the fallback. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD of the game), game, result, allen (his line), official (true once checked against the official stats), items [{tag, scope (nfl, bills or blank), title, text, line}]. The section hides itself when items is empty or once a newer game starts.
